*19 I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live: (Deuteronomy 30:19 KJV)*

The fact that God is saying that we have a choice, shows that we have a free will. The churches that teach that God controls everything, or as they say that God is sovereign, and therefore nothing happens but what God allows it, then how do they explain this verse, as it shows that mankind has a choice whether we get life or death, blessings or curses. God does not even know in advance everything that will happen, as He chooses to not look upon evil (Jeremiah 19:5).

If a person really believes that God causes sickness, diseases, deformities, and early death, then why would we resist them, and take medicine, etc. If it is good then it is from God, and if it is bad it is from the devil (John 10:10). If a person believes the bad comes from God, then why would anyone want to serve a bad God? Use your head, and know that God is love (1 John 4:8), and all good (James 1:17). If you blame God for the works of the devil, that is blasphemy against God, and is unforgivable as Jesus said (Matthew 12:31-32), and will send you to hell, even if you have been born again (see “New Revelations” page on our web site). Think about it – choose life.
